purpose: Cover US-17503: --level and --persona flags, the exit matrix (section 3.2), the two verdict lines (section 2.3) and the persona-grouped text report (section 4) of the DEFINE step 2 persona-levels spec. Shares `formatVerdictLines` with the Readiness tab (PR C).
title: rcf define readiness --level / --persona flags, exit matrix and verdict wording

testCases.description: Parameterised exit matrix across all rows of spec section 3.2 (no flag, --check <stage>, --check all, --level intent, --level build, --level + --check).
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/readiness.test.js::readiness cli: AC-17503-1 exit matrix (parameterised: --check + --level combinations)

testCases.description: --level intent exits 0 on a tree where every PO check passes.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/readiness.test.js::readiness cli: AC-17503-2 --level intent exits 0 when PO is clean

testCases.description: --level intent exits 4 when any PO check fails.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/readiness.test.js::readiness cli: AC-17503-3 --level intent exits 4 when PO fails

testCases.description: --level build exits 4 on an unacknowledged D3 failure even when every blocking stage passes; the [warn] line still prints.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/readiness.test.js::readiness cli: AC-17503-4 --level build exits 4 on a failing tree and prints warn lines for unacked warn-with-ack stages

testCases.description: --check all exit behaviour unchanged on a warn-with-ack-only failure: 0 with a stderr [warn] line.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/readiness.test.js::readiness cli: AC-17503-5 --check all unchanged on warn-with-ack

testCases.description: --persona productOwner collapses the engineer block to one line and leaves the exit code identical to the no-flag invocation; same for engineer and the PO block.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/readiness.test.js::readiness cli: AC-17503-6 --persona filters text and does not change exit

testCases.description: --level ship exits 2 with the usage line naming intent|build.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/readiness.test.js::readiness cli: AC-17503-7 unknown --level exits 2 with usage line

testCases.description: --persona architect exits 2 with the usage line naming productOwner|engineer.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/readiness.test.js::readiness cli: AC-17503-7 unknown --persona exits 2 with usage line

testCases.description: --json --level intent emits _meta.level === 'intent' and carries levels and personas.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/readiness.test.js::readiness cli: AC-17503-8 --json --level intent carries _meta.level and preserves levels + personas

testCases.description: On a failing tree the text report puts the product-owner block before the engineer block and every per-check line carries the persona inside the parenthesis after over.
testCases.testPointer: test/cli/readiness.test.js::readiness cli: AC-17503-9 text report groups PO before engineer with persona in detail lines

testCases.description: formatVerdictLines builds the four exact strings in spec section 2.3 (L1 ok, L1 not ok, L2 ok, L2 not ok) from crafted fixture results.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/readiness.test.js::readiness (ADR-4126): formatVerdictLines returns the section 2.3 wording
